questions.q: What does a catalog's MANAGED LOCATION control?
options: Where Unity Catalog stores data for a managed table created inside that catalog, if the table doesn't specify its own location
Which users can query the catalog
The pricing tier the catalog uses
The Databricks Runtime version for any cluster attached to it
questions.explain: This is a real ADLS Gen2 path — the literal home for everything Unity Catalog manages in that catalog.

questions.q: How does creating bronze, silver, and gold as real schemas relate to Chapter 3?
options: It's the real setup step behind everything Chapter 3 already built — those names genuinely are schemas within a catalog
It requires renaming every table built in Chapter 3
Chapter 3's bronze/silver/gold naming has no relationship to real schemas
It replaces the medallion architecture naming convention entirely
questions.explain: This exactly matches the naming convention this course has used since Lesson 25.

questions.q: What does SHOW SCHEMAS IN nyc_taxi do?
options: Lists the schemas that already exist within the nyc_taxi catalog, useful for orientation before assuming a name is available
Creates a new schema named nyc_taxi
Deletes all schemas within nyc_taxi
Grants access to every schema in nyc_taxi
questions.explain: This is genuinely useful in a real workspace with many catalogs and schemas already created by other people.

questions.q: What is CREATE CATALOG IF NOT EXISTS used for?
options: Creating a new catalog, without erroring if a catalog with that name already exists
Only listing existing catalogs, never creating one
Deleting a catalog if it already exists
Renaming an existing catalog
questions.explain: The IF NOT EXISTS clause makes this safe to rerun without error.

questions.q: After creating the nyc_taxi catalog and its schemas, what does every bronze.trips reference from Chapter 3 gain?
options: A genuine home — the full name becomes nyc_taxi.bronze.trips, matching Lesson 39's real three-level namespace
Nothing changes; the references remain exactly as ambiguous as before
They must all be renamed to a completely different naming scheme
They become temporary views instead of persistent tables
questions.explain: This is the real, complete setup Chapter 3's pipeline should have run against from the start.
